description.value: Mount Pleasant Neighbourhood House is a community hub that has served the Mt. Pleasant neighbourhood of Vancouver since 1976, offering programs spanning childcare, family support, literacy, food security, newcomer services, and seniors programming. The building is fully wheelchair accessible on both floors and operates as a scent-reduced, inclusive space. A touring cyclist passing through could make use of the publicly available washrooms and free guest WiFi.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address, phone, and URL. The site explicitly mentions gender-diverse and multi-stall washrooms on both floors, and free WiFi for guests — both confirmed from website text. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, racks, showers, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Category 'Attractions' is a significant mismatch for a community social services centre.
No bike-specific amenities documented anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a community social services organisation (childcare, seniors programs, literacy, food security) — not a cycling tourism attraction or cyclist-oriented service stop. provenance.category_correction_reason: This is a community social services centre (childcare, literacy, food security, seniors programs), not a tourism attraction. 'Attractions' is a poor fit; a 'Services' or 'Rest Stop' category would be more appropriate if retained at all.
